currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific renovated Arena Fonte Nova: continuous oval pale membrane roof/closed underside/inner ring/exposed radial frame and cable masts, horseshoe three-bank green bowl/pale aisles, closed club belts and glazed restaurant bridge above the open southern field-level view toward the lake. Native-plan outer louvers/exposed original-ground columns/base services, attached entrance strip and local south approach steps, open neutral football floor/goals and two hanging neutral displays. No copied lettering, sponsor artwork, crowd or private texture. Separate Edificio Garagem, utility/ticket buildings, lake, roads and neighborhood remain native. Demolished predecessor, future proposals and temporary event installations excluded.
